blocks.text: With an immersive display and multidimensional sound, moto g 5G - 2024 takes your movies, shows, and games to the next level. Enjoy smooth gaming and seamless scrolling with a fast, fluid 6.6" 120Hz display. Hear every detail with the unbelievable clarity of Dolby Atmos on stereo speakers. Capture sharper low-light photos with a 50MP Quad Pixel camera system. And unleash it all with 5G speeds powered by a Snapdragon octa-core processor. Plus, with a massive battery and TurboPower charging, the fun never stops. You can even experience a little luxury with the vegan leather design. Upgrade your entertainment with moto g 5G - 2024.

items.label: Immersive 120Hz display* and Dolby Atmos
items.value: Watch movies and play games on a fast, fluid 6.6" display backed by multidimensional stereo sound.

items.label: 50MP Quad Pixel camera system**
items.value: Capture sharper photos day or night with 4x the light sensitivity—and explore up close using the Macro Vision lens.

items.label: Superfast 5G performance***
items.value: Unleash your entertainment at 5G speed with the Snapdragon 4 Gen 1 octa-core processor.

items.label: Massive battery and speedy charging
items.value: Work and play nonstop with a long-lasting 5000mAh battery, then fuel up fast with TurboPower.****

items.label: Premium design within reach
items.value: Stand out with a stunning look and comfortable feel, including a vegan leather back cover that’s soft to the touch and fingerprint resistant.

items.label: Tons of built-in ultrafast storage
items.value: Get plenty of room for photos, movies, songs, and apps—and add up to 1TB with a microSD card*****
